description: Defines a templated WebSocket class for handling WebSocket connections, including methods for sending, closing, subscribing, unsubscribing, and publishing messages, as well as managing connection state and user data.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: A templated class managing WebSocket connections, providing methods for data transmission, connection control, and pub/sub functionality.

methods.name: getUserData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the user data associated with the WebSocket.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection if not already closed or shutting down.

methods.name: sendFirstFragment
methods.description: Sends the first fragment of a message with specified opcode and compression.

methods.name: sendFragment
methods.description: Sends a continuation fragment of a message.

methods.name: sendLastFragment
methods.description: Sends the last fragment of a message.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends or buffers a WebSocket frame, handling compression, backpressure, and buffer management.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Sends a close frame, emits close event, and shuts down the connection.

methods.name: cork
methods.description: Corks the response to batch multiple sends, then uncorks after handler execution.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes the WebSocket to a topic.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes the WebSocket from a topic.

methods.name: isSubscribed
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket is subscribed to a specific topic.

methods.name: iterateTopics
methods.description: Iterates over all topics the WebSocket is subscribed to.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to a topic, if the WebSocket is subscribed to it.
